security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are documentation examples inside SKILL.md, including fenced code, sample SQL, and reference links. The skill does instruct reviewers to run pnpm scripts for automated checks, which can execute project-defined code in untrusted repositories. No prompt injection attempt or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Package manager commands in review workflow
remediation.suggestion: Mark command execution as optional, require user approval, and advise reviewing package scripts before running them.

remediation.issue: Allowed tools differ from command guidance
remediation.suggestion: State that command output should be supplied by the user when shell execution is unavailable or not trusted.
Use a clearly fake placeholder for sample credentials, such as EXAMPLE_API_KEY, to reduce scanner noise.

content.user_title: Review Code for Quality and Security
content.value_statement: Code reviews often miss security, performance, and coverage gaps. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured review checklist.
actual_capabilities: Identifies common security risks such as SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded secrets, and weak input validation.
Checks performance concerns including N+1 queries, unnecessary renders, blocking operations, and caching gaps.
Reviews maintainability indicators such as long functions, deep nesting, duplicate code, and unclear names.
Assesses test coverage expectations for critical code, business logic, utilities, and UI components.
Formats feedback by severity with concrete file and line references when available.
limitations: Does not include executable tooling or scripts in the skill package.
Depends on available repository files and the host agent permitted tools.
Cannot prove runtime behavior without running tests or profiling tools.
Security guidance is checklist-based and does not replace expert review.

use_cases.title: Pre-Merge Pull Request Review
use_cases.description: Review code changes before merge for security, performance, maintainability, and missing tests.

use_cases.title: Security-Focused Change Review
use_cases.description: Check authentication, authorization, input handling, secrets, and dependency risks in sensitive changes.

use_cases.title: Coverage and Quality Review
use_cases.description: Find missing edge case tests, weak assertions, slow tests, and unclear code structure.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Code Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this change for security, performance, maintainability, and tests. Prioritize findings by severity.

prompt_templates.title: Pull Request Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a feature branch before merge.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the changed files in this pull request. List blockers first, then high-value improvements and missing tests.

prompt_templates.title: Critical Path Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review for sensitive application code.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this authentication, payment, or data access code. Focus on abuse cases, authorization gaps, secrets, and input validation.

prompt_templates.title: Architecture Risk Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a larger change set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this design and implementation together. Identify security risks, performance bottlenecks, maintainability tradeoffs, and test strategy gaps.

output_examples.input: Review a new user search feature before merge.
output: High: User input needs stricter validation before database access.
Medium: Search results should use pagination to avoid slow responses.
Medium: Add tests for empty searches, invalid input, and permission boundaries.

output_examples.input: Review a React list component with new data processing.
output: High: Expensive processing may run on every render for large lists.
Medium: Extract formatting logic so it can be tested independently.
Low: Add documentation for the accepted item states.

output_examples.input: Review test coverage for a payment workflow.
output: Critical: Add tests for failed authorization and duplicate submission handling.
High: Cover timeout and retry behavior for the payment provider.
Medium: Add boundary tests for currency rounding and minimum amounts.

best_practices: Share the specific files, changed lines, and expected behavior before asking for review.
Ask for severity-ranked findings with clear reproduction or reasoning.
Run project tests separately when command execution is permitted and safe.
anti_patterns: Treating checklist output as a full security audit without manual verification.
Asking for broad review across a large repository without change context.
Running package scripts from untrusted dependencies without reviewing their effects.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews security, performance, maintainability, test coverage, documentation, and review feedback structure.

faq.question: Can it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: The skill describes useful test commands, but execution depends on the host agent and user approval.

faq.question: Is this a replacement for human review?
faq.answer: No. It helps organize review work, but humans should verify findings and business context.

faq.question: Does it support Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Small pull requests, changed files, target behavior, and test expectations produce the clearest reviews.

faq.question: How should risky command suggestions be handled?
faq.answer: Review package scripts first, get explicit approval, or ask the user to provide command output.
